name: Executive Report
description: Formal structured report with executive summary, findings table, recommendations, and next steps.

name: Project Proposal
description: Client or internal project proposal detailing scope, deliverables, milestones table, and budget.

name: Budget & Expense Ledger
description: Multi-column financial breakdown with line items, categories, quantities, unit costs, and totals.

name: KPI & Operations Tracker
description: Operational workbook tracking metrics, owners, targets, current status, and quarterly progress.

name: Presentation Deck
description: Clean visual slide deck covering problem statement, solution architecture, metrics, and roadmap with speaker notes.

name: Workshop & Training Slides
description: Structured training module with learning objectives, step-by-step modules, examples, and review questions.

name: Meeting Minutes & Action Log
description: Concise structured notes capturing attendees, decisions made, action owners table, and deadlines.

name: Multilingual Knowledge Brief
description: Structured brief or study guide organizing concepts, definitions, summary table, and checklist.
